priorityList: Use Dragonrage if the target will survive for at least 30 seconds.
Use Tip the Scales immediately before casting Fire Breath.
Cast Fire Breath at Empowerment Level 1 as a high priority.
Cast Eternity Surge at Empowerment Level 1 on cooldown.
Cast Deep Breath if the Strafing Run buff is about to expire (less than 2 seconds remaining).
Cast Deep Breath if talented into Imminent Destruction and Essence is needed.
Use Disintegrate as your primary Essence spender, prioritizing it when Mass Disintegrate stacks are active.
Chain Disintegrate early (when 1 tick remains) if you have Mass Disintegrate stacks or need to spend Essence quickly.
Cast Living Flame when Burnout, Leaping Flames, or Ancient Flame procs are active.
Cast Azure Sweep if the 2-piece set bonus is active and Eternity Surge's cooldown is 6 seconds or less.
Use Azure Strike as your mobile filler or when no other procs are available.
Use Hover to maintain mobility, especially if talented into Slipstream.
Activate offensive trinkets and combat potions during Dragonrage.
In pre-combat, cast Verdant Embrace if talented into Scarlet Adaptation to prep a damage buff.
In pre-combat, cast Living Flame to start the encounter with an active cast.
